question: Who among the following was appointed as Deputy Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of SBI General Insurance in June 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Mohd. Arif Khan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Mohd. Arif Khan** was appointed as the **Deputy Chief Executive Officer (CEO)** of **SBI General Insurance** in **June 2025**. This appointment highlights his extensive experience in the insurance and financial sectors. • SBI General Insurance is one of the leading insurance companies in India, providing a wide range of general insurance solutions. **Deputy CEO** positions are crucial for strategic decision-making and operational excellence. • The appointment of Mohd. Arif Khan is a strategic move by SBI General Insurance to strengthen its leadership team and expand its market presence. • Prior to this role, Mohd. Arif Khan has held various senior leadership positions in the insurance and financial services industry, showcasing his expertise in business development, operations, and customer service. • This move aligns with SBI General Insurance’s growth trajectory and its vision to enhance customer-centricity and innovation in the insurance domain.
